text: Where Areesh is warmed so the curd separates, Karish is simply drained: the soured skimmed milk sits on a reed mat and loses its whey by gravity and squeezing.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The soured skimmed milk sits on a reed mat, and is squeezed from time to time.
The last of the whey is left to run out over a few more hours.
